question: In which year was IIT Roorkee formally designated as an IIT?
ground_truth: IIT Roorkee was formally designated as an IIT on September 21, 2001, through a Government of India ordinance.
answer: IIT Roorkee was formally designated as an Indian Institute of Technology in 1959.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

question: What is the minimum educational qualification for M.Tech admission in terms of degree duration?
ground_truth: Candidates must hold a four-year bachelor's degree or equivalent for M.Tech admission.
answer:
The minimum educational qualification for M.Tech admission in terms of degree duration is a Bachelor’s degree (B.Tech or equivalent), with specific exemptions and conditions based on the institution and degree type. For applicants with a B.Tech degree from Ministry of Education (MoE) funded Technical Institutions (formerly CFTIs), the requirement of a national-level test like GATE/NET is exempted if they have a CGPA of 8.0 or above. Additionally, applicants with a 4-year Bachelor’s degree from institutions other than MoE-funded technical institutions are required to have a minimum CGPA of 7.50 on a 10-point scale or 75% marks and qualify in a national-level test, unless they are from IITs or have a medical degree (MBBS/BAMS/BHMS/BDS). 

For applicants with MBBS/BAMS/BHMS/BDS degrees, the minimum CGPA is 6.0 on a 10-point scale, and they are exempted from the national-level test requirement. Similarly, applicants with MS/MD degrees from Indian universities are exempted from both CGPA and national-level test requirements.

Thus, the minimum degree duration is a 4-year Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent), with specific exemptions for certain institutions and degrees. [S1]

answer:
The minimum educational qualification for M.Tech admission varies by specialization, but generally, the required degree is a Bachelor’s degree (B.Tech/B.E.) or a Master’s degree (M.Sc./M.Tech.) depending on the program.

question: What is the minimum educational qualification for M.Tech admission in terms of degree duration?
ground_truth: Candidates must hold a four-year bachelor's degree or equivalent for M.Tech admission.
answer:
The minimum educational qualification for M.Tech admission requires a Bachelor’s degree, with specific duration and field requirements depending on the specialization and category.

For most M.Tech programmes, the minimum educational qualification is a **Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline**, such as:

- **Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or Engineering Physics** [S2][S4]
- **Bachelor’s degree in Civil/ Agricultural Engineering, Hydrology, or Data Science & Artificial Intelligence** [S2]
- **Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical/ Industrial/ Production Engineering, Mechatronics, or Aerospace Engineering** [S2]
- **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science & Engineering, Data Science, or Mathematics and Computing** [S2]
- **Bachelor’s degree in Metallurgy, Materials, or Chemical Engineering** [S2]
- **Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering** [S4]
- **Four-year Bachelor’s degree (4 years)** or **five-year integrated degree** in relevant engineering disciplines [S8]

Additionally, for candidates from **Ministry of Education (MoE) funded Technical Institutions (CFTIs)**, a **four-year Bachelor’s degree** (B.Tech or B.E.) is sufficient, and the requirement of a national-level test (e.g., GATE/NET) is exempted if the CGPA is 8.0 or above [S1][S2].

3.1 Full-Time Sponsored Candidates

These candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

which admission is being sought.

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

Note:

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

2. Candidates admitted under R&T and PGT Schemes whose selection are

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

3. Candidates with or without GATE can apply. Preference will be given to GATE

qualified candidates.

4. No self-sponsored candidate will be admitted .

5. Sponsored students will not be eligible for any scholarship, prize etc.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

question: What is the Golden Girl scheme in PhD admissions?
ground_truth: Golden Girl scheme is a special PhD admission category to encourage female candidates, offering additional opportunities.
answer: The Golden Girl Scheme is a direct admission scheme for female candidates in Ph.D. programs. Eligibility requires that the candidate be a first-rank holder (Gold Medallist) in her qualifying degree from an IIT or an institute/university within the Top 50 ranks (overall category) in the NIRF in the most recent year. The requirement of qualifying in an All India Level Exam (e.g., GATE, NET) is exempted under this scheme, though all other minimum eligibility criteria (MEQs) apply as per institute policy. Fellowship is provided at par with the Institute's Assistantship. The intake is supernumerary, and selection is done through an interview by the Department/ Centre/ School. Candidates appearing in the qualifying degree are not considered under this scheme. The First Rank Holder (Gold Medallist) certificate must pertain to the qualifying degree (bachelor’s/master’s). [S5]

answer: Yes, M.Tech./M.Arch./MURP candidates pursuing a postgraduate degree at IIT Roorkee are permitted to switch over to the Ph.D. Programme after the first year, subject to satisfying eligibility criteria as per applicable rules. [S5]

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

(iii) withholding of results

(iv) suspension, rustication or expulsion from hostel or mess

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

which admission is being sought.

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

Note:

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

2. Candidates admitted under R&T and PGT Schemes whose selection are

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

3. Candidates with or without GATE can apply. Preference will be given to GATE

qualified candidates.

4. No self-sponsored candidate will be admitted .

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

Roorkee.

qualified candidates.

Annexures 1-2

Postgraduate Programmes 1

1.1 Introduction to Postgraduate Academic Programmes

IIT Roorkee offers 57 full time postgraduate programmes in various

disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Planning, Sciences,

Management and Design. In addition, the departments of Hydrology and

Water Resources Development and Management, also offer PG Diploma

programmes.

Details of M.Arch./ M.Tech./ M.U.R.P. programmes available in different

departments along with their codes, minimum educational qualifications for

admission are given in Table-1.

The curriculum structure of these is given on the Institute website:

www.iitr.ac.in

The regulations in force determine the general academic requirements for

the above programmes for full-time and part-time students. The minimum

duration of all academic programmes would be four semesters for Full-Time

candidates and six semesters for Part-Time candidates.

1.2 Dual Degree Programme

The M.Tech./M.Arch./MURP candidates pursuing PG degree in any

Department/Centre/School of IITR are permitted to switch over to Ph.D.

Programme after 1st year subject to satisfying eligibility criteria as per

applicable rules.

Admission Categories

Eligibility Requirements for Admission to M.Tech./M.Arch./ MURP Degree Programmes

For Indian Candidates

The candidates holding a four-year bachelor’s degree or equivalent and meeting the minimum educational qualifications as given in Table-1 are eligible to seek admission to M.Tech./M.Arch./MURP programmes.

In addition, candidates of General, Gen-EWS and OBC category must have secured at least 60% marks or CGPA of 6.00 on a 10 point scale at the qualifying degree level; but for SC/ST/PWD category candidates, this percentage is 55% or 5.50 CGPA on a 10 point scale. The marks awarded for the qualifying degree will be considered for eligibility.

Candidates having AMIE/ AMIS/ AMIIChE/ AMIIM/ Grad IETE, who possess B.Sc.

or Diploma in engineering and have at least three years research, teaching or

other professional experience at the submission of last date of application

acquired in relevant field, are also eligible to apply for admission to M.Tech.

courses.

For International Candidates

Candidates holding a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in

Engineering/Technology/Architecture/Planning/ Design and meeting the

minimum educational qualifications are eligible to seek admission to

M.Tech/M.Arch./MURP programmes.

3.1 Full-Time Sponsored Candidates

These candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

which admission is being sought.

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

purpose, if needed. The Medical Board will decide the programmes which

cannot be offered to a candidate, on the basis of the nature of his/her

disability.

In matters of interpretation of the provisions or any matter not covered

(h)

herein this Information Brochure, the decision of the Chairman, Senate IIT

Roorkee shall be final and binding on both the parties.

5.2. Details of Online Application Submission

5.2.1 How to Apply

Before applying, candidates are advised to read the PG Information Brochure

2026 carefully.

Candidates must follow the following Steps while applying online:

a) Access the URL:

https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Admission%20To%20M.Tech.M.Arch.M.U.R.P.%20Pr ogrammes.html

a) M.Tech./M.Arch./MURP admissions for Sponsored Candidates 2026-2027

b) Click on “Apply Online”

c) “Register New Account” if applying for the first time or “Sign in” if already registered

d) Complete Application Form.

e) Pay fee online using option “Proceed for Payment”

5.2.2 Documents to be Uploaded

Before applying, candidates are advised to keep ready the scanned

copies of following testimonials for uploading (Maximum size of each

document: 5 MB):

1. Applicant Photo (In JPG)

2. Applicant Signature (In JPG)

3. 10th Marksheet/ Certificate (in pdf)

4. 12th/Diploma marksheet(s)/Certificate (in pdf)

5. UG all semesters/year Marksheets and UG Degree/ Provisional

Certificate (In a single pdf)

6. PG All semesters/year marksheet and Degree/Provisional Certificate

(If applicable)(In a single pdf)

7. UDID card (if applicable) (In pdf)

8. SC/ST/OBC-NC/GEN-EWS Category Certificate (if applicable) (in pdf)

9. Sponsorship, NOC, Experience Certificate as per Annexure-2 (in pdf)

10. GATE score card, if applicable

11. In case of non-availability of any of the certificates, upload an

undertaking as per Annexure-1.

5.2.3 Application Fee (Non-refundable)

For General/GEN-EWS/OBC Category: Rs. 500/-

For PwD/SC/ST Category: Rs. 250/-

The requisite fee can be paid online using net banking or debit/credit

card facilities. Additional charges will be applicable as per the rule of

the concerned bank.

The Fee will not be accepted through any other mode.

6.1 Basis of Selection for Admission

Admission category Basis for Selection

Selection through Army Headquarters.

Sponsored under Post Graduate Training (PGT) Scheme for Armed Forces.

Selection through DRDO Headquarters.

Sponsored under R&T scheme for DRDO officials.

Other Sponsored (full Time and Part Time). Interview and/or written test or as decided by the concerned Department/ Centre/School

Offer letter shall be issued by Academic Affairs Office, IIT Roorkee.

6.2 Fee Structure

The Institute fee structure is available on:

https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Institute%20Fees.html

Revised fee structure if any, will reflect automatically.

6.3 Academic Registration

A system of registration is followed for all the students joining the Institute. The selected candidates will have to register themselves online on the date and time to be intimated to them. Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

3.1 Full-Time Sponsored Candidates

These candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

Note:

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

2. Candidates admitted under R&T and PGT Schemes whose selection are

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

3. Candidates with or without GATE can apply. Preference will be given to GATE

qualified candidates.

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

those who are below 45 years of age.

attendance requirements.

regular full-time student.

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

candidates.

Roorkee.

qualified candidates.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

Paper and Packaging Technology, Polymer and Process Engineering and Applied

Mathematics and Scientific Computing. The third is the Greater Noida Campus Centre in

The campus at Roorkee is spread over 356 acres of landscaped lush greenery. Nestled

within this are several heritage buildings, modern academic departments, twenty-one

hostels, messes, hospital, school, banks, community centres, indoor and outdoor sports

facilities which include three sports stadiums, a modern swimming pool, yoga bhawan,

students’ clubs and several activitycentresand other buildings.

The Degree of Doctor of Philosophy is granted for research work in areas recognized by the

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

3. If applying for the first time, register a new account; otherwise, sign in.  
4. Complete the online application form.  
5. Pay the application fee online using net banking or debit/credit card facilities.  

Candidates must also upload the following documents:  
- Applicant photo and signature (in JPG)  
- 10th, 12th/Diploma, and UG/PG mark sheets and degree certificates (in PDF)  
- SC/ST/OBC-NC/GEN-EWS Category Certificate (if applicable)  
- Sponsorship, NOC, and Experience Certificate as per Annexure-2 (for sponsored candidates)  
- GATE score card (if applicable)  
- An undertaking as per Annexure-1, if any certificate is unavailable  

The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/GEN-EWS/OBC categories and Rs. 250/- for PwD/SC/ST categories (non-refundable).  

After submission, candidates must attend document verification as per the schedule (July 13 or 14, 2026), and regular classes will start on July 16, 2026. [S4]

answer:
To apply for PG programmes at IIT Roorkee, candidates must follow these steps:

2. Click on “Apply Online” [S4].

3. If applying for the first time, register a new account; otherwise, sign in [S4].

4. Complete the online application form [S4].

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

question: What are the steps for PhD application submission?
ground_truth: PhD application involves online registration, filling academic details, uploading certificates, research proposal, and payment of fee before deadline.
answer:
The steps for PhD application submission typically include:

1. Researching and selecting programs and departments that align with your field and interests.  
2. Preparing required documents: resume, statement of purpose, letters of recommendation, and transcripts.  
3. Taking standardized tests (e.g., GRE, TOEFL/IELTS) if required by the program.  
4. Applying through the university’s online portal or application system.  
5. Submitting application materials by the deadline.  
6. Receiving admission decision, which may include an interview.  
7. Accepting the offer and completing enrollment paperwork.  

Note: Requirements and processes vary by institution and field.

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

question: What documents are required to be uploaded for M.Tech application?
ground_truth: Required documents include qualifying degree certificate, mark sheets, category certificate if applicable, GATE score card, photograph, signature, and sponsorship certificate for sponsored category.
answer:
For M.Tech application, the following documents are required to be uploaded:

1. Colour photograph (only in JPEG)  
2. Signature (only in JPEG)  
3. Gen-EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/UDID Card (PDF) (as applicable)  
4. 10th Certificate/Marksheet (in single PDF)  
5. 12th Certificate/Diploma and Marksheet (in single PDF)  
6. Bachelor’s Degree or Provisional/Consolidated Marksheet (in single PDF)  
7. Master’s Degree or Provisional/Consolidated Marksheet (in single PDF), if applicable  
8. Experience certificate(s) and No Objection Certificate (Annexure-2) for In-Service candidates (in single PDF)  
9. GATE scorecard/NET scorecard/Fellowship award letter (in single PDF) (If applicable)  
10. Certificate of first rank/gold medal issued by the Institute/University (applicable only for Golden Girl Scheme for Females)  
11. In case of non-availability of any of the certificate, upload an undertaking as given in Annexure-1.  

Note: All documents should be in PDF format and not password protected. [S3]

question: How is selection for PhD done at IIT Roorkee?
ground_truth: PhD selection is based on academic performance, GATE/NET qualification, written test and/or interview conducted by department.
answer:
The selection process for PhD programs at IIT Roorkee involves the following steps:

1. **Eligibility**: Candidates must have a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field, with a strong academic record.
2. **Application**: Candidates apply through the IIT Roorkee PhD admission portal, submitting academic transcripts, a research proposal, and letters of recommendation.
3. **Selection**: Shortlisted candidates are interviewed by a panel of faculty members. The interview assesses research potential, knowledge of the field, and alignment with ongoing research.
4. **Admission**: Final selection is based on the candidate’s academic performance, research proposal, and interview performance. Admission is typically merit-based and competitive.

Note: IIT Roorkee also conducts a centralized admission process through the IITs' official portal, and candidates may also apply through the IIT PhD admission system.

question: What is the procedure for sponsored candidates to get admission?
ground_truth: Sponsored candidates need minimum two years full-time work experience, sponsorship letter from employer, and must meet minimum educational qualifications.
answer:
Sponsored candidates must have at least two years of full-time work experience in a responsible capacity in a registered firm/company/industry/educational and research institution/government or quasi-government/autonomous organization in the relevant field [S1]. For full-time sponsored candidates, the organization must be a public sector undertaking, a public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange, or a private concern with annual turnover exceeding Rs. 5.0 crores over the past two years [S1]. For part-time sponsored candidates, the organization must be located in Roorkee or within a 20 km radius of Roorkee [S1]. 

Candidates must submit a sponsorship certificate from the relevant authority (e.g., Registrar for IIT Roorkee staff or appointing authority for SRIC project fellows) [S1]. GATE-qualified candidates may also be considered for admission as part-time PG students and simultaneously appointed as Project Fellows/JRF in externally funded research projects, provided the project duration remains at least one and a half years at the time of registration [S1]. 

No self-sponsored candidates will be admitted, and sponsored students are not eligible for scholarships or prizes [S1]. Candidates with or without GATE qualification can apply, with preference given to GATE-qualified candidates [S1]. 

Note: Candidates working in institutions awarding PG degrees are not eligible, except for QIP candidates [S1].

question: What is the procedure for sponsored candidates to get admission?
ground_truth: Sponsored candidates need minimum two years full-time work experience, sponsorship letter from employer, and must meet minimum educational qualifications.
answer:
Sponsored candidates must apply online through the IIT Roorkee admission portal. The procedure involves the following steps:

1. Access the URL: https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Admission%20To%20M.Tech.M.Arch.M.U.R.P.%20Programmes.html [S2][S5]
2. Click on “Apply Online” [S2][S5]
3. Register a new account or sign in if already registered [S2][S5]
4. Complete the online application form [S2][S5]
5. Pay the application fee online using net banking or debit/credit card facilities [S2][S5][S9]
6. Upload the required documents, including applicant photo, signature, 10th/12th mark sheets, UG/PG mark sheets, sponsorship certificate, and GATE score card if applicable [S2][S5][S9]
7. Submit the application form and receive a confirmation [S2][S5]

For full-time sponsored candidates, the sponsoring organization must be a public sector undertaking, a public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange, or a private concern with an annual turnover exceeding Rs. 5.0 crores in the past two years [S1]. For part-time sponsored candidates, the organization must be located at Roorkee or within a 20 km radius of Roorkee [S1][S2].

Candidates must meet the minimum work experience requirement of two years in a responsible capacity in a relevant field [S1]. Additionally, candidates must satisfy the eligibility criteria, including minimum educational qualifications and CGPA/percentage requirements as per the category (GEN, SC/ST, OBC, etc.) [S8][S10].

Selection for admission is based on merit, and candidates may be called for a written test or interview

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

question: What is the process for international candidates to apply for M.Tech?
ground_truth: International candidates holding bachelor's degree in relevant field must apply through international admission portal and meet minimum qualifications.
answer:
International candidates can apply for M.Tech programs through the following general process:

1. **Check Eligibility**: Ensure the candidate holds a relevant bachelor’s degree (usually in engineering or a related field) and meets the institution’s academic requirements.

2. **Choose a Program and University**: Select a university offering M.Tech with international student admission policies.

3. **Submit Application**: Apply online through the university’s official portal, typically requiring:
   - Official transcripts
   - Standardized test scores (e.g., GRE, TOEFL/IELTS)
   - Statement of purpose
   - Letters of recommendation
   - Resume/CV

4. **Meet Visa Requirements**: Some universities require a visa application, which may involve securing a student visa based on the country’s immigration rules.

5. **Pay Application and Tuition Fees**: Most institutions charge application and tuition fees.

6. **Attend Interviews (if required)**: Some programs require an interview for admission.

Note: Requirements and deadlines vary by country and university. Candidates should consult the specific university's international admissions website for detailed instructions.

3.1 Full-Time Sponsored Candidates

These candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

which admission is being sought.

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

Note:

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

2. Candidates admitted under R&T and PGT Schemes whose selection are

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

3. Candidates with or without GATE can apply. Preference will be given to GATE

qualified candidates.

4. No self-sponsored candidate will be admitted .

5. Sponsored students will not be eligible for any scholarship, prize etc.

question: How to apply for dual degree programme switching from M.Tech to PhD?
ground_truth: M.Tech students can apply for switching to PhD after first year by submitting application through department and satisfying eligibility criteria.
answer:
You cannot directly "switch" from an M.Tech to a PhD program in most institutions; typically, a PhD is pursued after completing a Master’s degree, and admission to a PhD requires separate application processes. To apply for a PhD after an M.Tech, you should:

1. Identify universities or research institutions offering PhD programs in your field of interest.
2. Check eligibility criteria (e.g., academic records, research proposal, GRE/GATE scores if required).
3. Prepare a research proposal and contact potential supervisors.
4. Apply through the institution’s official PhD admission portal, often with deadlines and application forms specific to the program.

Note: Some institutions may allow direct PhD admission from M.Tech with a strong research background, but this is rare and usually requires exceptional academic performance and research potential.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

question: How to apply for dual degree programme switching from M.Tech to PhD?
ground_truth: M.Tech students can apply for switching to PhD after first year by submitting application through department and satisfying eligibility criteria.
answer:
The dual degree programme switching from M.Tech to PhD is permitted for M.Tech./M.Arch./MURP candidates who are pursuing a postgraduate degree at IIT Roorkee. According to the document, such candidates are allowed to switch over to a Ph.D. programme after the first year, subject to satisfying the eligibility criteria as per applicable rules [S5, page 1]. 

However, the provided sources do not specify the detailed application process, required documents, or any specific deadlines for this transition. For more information, candidates are advised to refer to the respective department, centre, or school's webpage or contact the Academic Affairs Office at IIT Roorkee [S8, page 24].

question: What is the procedure for part-time PhD research scholars?
ground_truth: Part-time research scholars must be employed, have employer NOC, minimum experience, and attend coursework as per department requirements.
answer:
Part-time PhD research scholars typically engage in doctoral research while balancing other commitments, such as employment or family responsibilities. The procedure generally involves:  
- Approval from the university/department for part-time status.  
- A structured research plan and timeline approved by the supervisor and committee.  
- Regular progress meetings and milestone reviews.  
- Completion of coursework and research requirements at a reduced pace, often with adjusted deadlines.  
- Full-time research obligations are usually limited to a few hours per week, though the total time to complete the PhD may extend beyond standard full-time timelines.  

Note: Part-time options vary by institution and field; some universities may have specific policies or restrictions.

question: What is the procedure for part-time PhD research scholars?
ground_truth: Part-time research scholars must be employed, have employer NOC, minimum experience, and attend coursework as per department requirements.
answer:
The procedure for part-time PhD research scholars (PTRS) at IIT Roorkee involves two sub-categories:

- **In-Service Internal Research Scholar (P-ISIRS):** The candidate must be a regular employee of IIT Roorkee.  
- **In-Service External Research Scholar (P-ISERS):** The candidate must have at least two years of experience in a Government / Semi-Government organization / Public Sector Undertaking / AICTE / UGC recognized educational institute, or in a registered company with an annual turnover of more than ₹20 crores. Additionally, for P-ISERS, the requirement of leave of absence from the employer is waived off if the candidate is working within 100 km of IIT Roorkee.  

At the time of academic registration, candidates must have permission from their current employer for pursuing the Ph.D. program with adequate leave of absence to complete coursework requirements.  

Note: These requirements are in addition to the general eligibility criteria for part-time research scholars, which are outlined under 4.3.2. Part-time Research Scholar (PTRS). [S2]

question: What is the procedure for part-time PhD research scholars?
ground_truth: Part-time research scholars must be employed, have employer NOC, minimum experience, and attend coursework as per department requirements.
answer:
The procedure for part-time PhD research scholars (PTRS) at IIT Roorkee includes the following conditions:

- The candidate must be a regular employee of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (in the case of In-Service Internal Research Scholar, P-ISIRS) or working within 100 km of IIT Roorkee (in the case of In-Service External Research Scholar, P-ISERS), with the requirement of leave of absence from the employer waived off for the latter [S2].

- For In-Service External Research Scholar (P-ISERS), the candidate must have at least two years of experience in a Government / Semi-Government organization / Public Sector Undertaking / AICTE / UGC recognized educational institute, or in a registered company with an annual turnover of more than ₹20 crores [S2].

- The part-time student must attend all lectures, tutorials, and practical classes for the prescribed courses and meet attendance requirements [S4].

- The status of a part-time student will not be changed to a regular full-time student [S4].

- Candidates working in institutions or organizations with which IIT Roorkee has a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) may apply, provided they meet the Common Minimum Eligibility Criteria (CMEC) and Minimum Educational Qualification (MEQ) [S5].

- The part-time student must be registered as a full-time scholar in the institute/college where the PhD registration is sought [S5].

question: What is the procedure for part-time PhD research scholars?
ground_truth: Part-time research scholars must be employed, have employer NOC, minimum experience, and attend coursework as per department requirements.
answer:
The procedure for part-time PhD research scholars at IIT Roorkee includes the following conditions:

- The candidate must be working in an organization that is either a government or semi-government organization, a public sector undertaking, a public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange, or a private concern with an annual turnover exceeding ₹20 crores.  
- For candidates working in such organizations, they must have permission from their current employer to pursue the Ph.D. program with adequate leave of absence to complete coursework requirements.  
- The part-time research scholar (PTRS) category includes two sub-types:  
  - **In-Service Internal Research Scholar (P-ISIRS)**: The candidate must be a regular employee of IIT Roorkee.  
  - **In-Service External Research Scholar (P-ISERS)**: The candidate must be working within 100 km of IIT Roorkee, and the requirement for leave of absence from the employer is waived off.  
- The part-time student will attend all lectures, tutorials, and practical classes as prescribed and must meet attendance requirements.  
- The status of a part-time student will not change to full-time.  
- Candidates must meet the minimum educational qualifications (MEQ) and common minimum eligibility criteria (CMEC) for admission.  
- The admission process follows the general procedure outlined in the brochure, including online application, document verification, and registration.  

For more details, refer to Section 4.3.2 (Part-Time Research Scholar) and Section 4.4.3 (MoU with IIT Roorkee) [S1][S2][S3].

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

question: What is the minimum percentage required for General category candidates for M.Tech admission?
ground_truth: General, Gen-EWS and OBC category candidates must have at least 60% marks or CGPA 6.00 on 10 point scale at qualifying degree.
answer:
The minimum percentage required for General category candidates for M.Tech admission is 60% marks, which corresponds to a minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of 6.0 on a 10-point scale [S1]. 

Note: This requirement applies to applicants with a Master’s degree. For applicants with a Bachelor’s degree from institutions other than Ministry of Education (MoE) funded Technical Institutions, the minimum CGPA is 7.50 (75% marks), but this is not for General category candidates in the context of M.Tech admission under the general category as specified in the document. The 60% mark requirement is explicitly stated for General category candidates with a Master’s degree.

ground_truth: General, Gen-EWS and OBC category candidates must have at least 60% marks or CGPA 6.00 on 10 point scale at qualifying degree.
answer: The minimum percentage required for General category candidates for M.Tech admission is 60%. [S1]

qualified candidates.

Admission Categories

Eligibility Requirements for Admission to M.Tech./M.Arch./ MURP Degree Programmes

For Indian Candidates

The candidates holding a four-year bachelor’s degree or equivalent and meeting the minimum educational qualifications as given in Table-1 are eligible to seek admission to M.Tech./M.Arch./MURP programmes.

In addition, candidates of General, Gen-EWS and OBC category must have secured at least 60% marks or CGPA of 6.00 on a 10 point scale at the qualifying degree level; but for SC/ST/PWD category candidates, this percentage is 55% or 5.50 CGPA on a 10 point scale. The marks awarded for the qualifying degree will be considered for eligibility.

answer: There is no fixed minimum percentage for SC/ST/PWD candidates for M.Tech admissions. The exact percentage may vary by institution and course.

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

qualified candidates.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

PhD students, in consultation with their supervisors, have options to enrol in the Joint
