(i) University of Alberta, Canada

(ii) University of Saskatchewan, Canada (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering)

(iii) Queen’s University, Canada

(iv) University of Strasbourg, France

(v) Niigata University, Japan

(vi) Asian Institute of Technology, Thailand

(vii) Institute of Engineering, Tribhuvan University (IOETU)

(viii) National Tsing Hua University, Taiwan

(ix) Loughborough University, U.K

For more details, please visit: https://ir.iitr.ac.in/JointDegree

IIT Roorkee has also approved Cotutelle Agreements with the following universities. A Cotutelle Agreement is a formal academic arrangement between two universities in different countries that allows a Ph.D. student to be jointly enrolled, supervised, and examined at both institutions.

1. University of Groningen, Netherlands

2. University of Ontario Institute of Technology, Canada

3. Vrije university Brussels, Belgium

4. University of Trento, Italy

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

question: What work experience is required for full-time sponsored M.Tech candidates?
ground_truth: Full-time sponsored candidates must have minimum two years full-time work experience in responsible capacity in relevant field.
answer: Full-time sponsored M.Tech candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work experience in a responsible capacity in a Registered Firm/Company/Industry/Educational and Research Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field [S1]. The organization must be either a public sector undertaking or a public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange, or a private concern with an annual turnover exceeding Rs. 5.0 crores over the past two years [S1]. For candidates employed in an educational institution, the institution must be recognized by AICTE [S1].

The organization must be either a public sector undertaking or a public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange, or a private concern whose annual turnover during the past two years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores. 3.1 Full-Time Sponsored Candidates

These candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

which admission is being sought.

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

Note:

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

2. Candidates admitted under R&T and PGT Schemes whose selection are

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

3. Candidates with or without GATE can apply. Preference will be given to GATE

qualified candidates.

answer: No, candidates with AMIE (Associate Member of the Institution of Engineers) are not eligible for direct admission to M.Tech at IIT Roorkee. IIT Roorkee typically requires a Bachelor's degree (B.Tech or equivalent) for M.Tech admissions. AMIE is not considered equivalent to a B.Tech degree for this purpose. For official eligibility, refer to IIT Roorkee's admission guidelines.

question: Are candidates with AMIE eligible for M.Tech at IIT Roorkee?
ground_truth: Yes, candidates with AMIE/AMIS/AMIIChE/AMIIM/Grad IETE plus B.Sc. or Diploma and three years research/teaching/professional experience are eligible.
answer: Yes, candidates with AMIE (Civil) are eligible for M.Tech at IIT Roorkee, provided they have at least 3 years of research/teaching/other professional experience in responsible capacities. This is specified under the M.Tech. Hydrology (HYD) programme, where the eligibility includes "AMIE (Civil) with B.Sc. or Engineering Diploma qualifications with at least 3 years research/teaching /other professional experience in responsible capacities." Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

question: What is common minimum eligibility criteria for PhD admission?
ground_truth: Common minimum eligibility includes master's degree in relevant discipline with minimum marks and valid GATE/NET or equivalent qualification.
answer:
Common minimum eligibility criteria for PhD admission typically include:

- A bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field (often with a strong GPA, e.g., 3.0 or higher on a 4.0 scale).

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

question: What is common minimum eligibility criteria for PhD admission?
ground_truth: Common minimum eligibility includes master's degree in relevant discipline with minimum marks and valid GATE/NET or equivalent qualification.
answer:
The common minimum eligibility criteria for PhD admission at IIT Roorkee include:

- For general, GEN-EWS, and OBC categories: a minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of 6.0 on a 10-point scale or 60% marks. For SC/ST/PWD categories, the minimum CGPA is 5.50 on a 10-point scale or 55% marks. [S1]
- Qualifying in a national-level test such as GATE, CEED, JEST, UGC-NET, CSIR-NET (including lectureship/Assistant Professorship/Ph.D. only) or holding a national-level fellowship. [S1]
- Exemptions from the national-level test requirement for specific categories:
  - Candidates with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from IITs with a CGPA of 8.0 or above are exempted. [S1]
  - Candidates with a 4-year Bachelor’s degree from Ministry of Education (MoE) funded Technical Institutions (CFTIs) with a CGPA of 8.0 or above are exempted. [S1]
  - Candidates with a 4-year Bachelor’s degree from institutions other than MoE-funded institutions with a CGPA of 7.50 or above and qualified in a national-level test are eligible. [S1]
  - Candidates with MBBS/BAMS/BHMS/BDS degrees from Indian universities/institutions with a minimum CGPA of 6.0 or 60% are exempted. [S1]
  - Candidates with MS/MD degrees from Indian universities/institutions are exempted from both CGPA and national-level test requirements. [S1]
- For candidates from the SAKUNTALA Fellowship scheme: a B.Tech./B.E./B.Arch./B

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

ground_truth: General category candidates need 60% or 6.0 CGPA for PhD admission, while SC/ST/PWD need 55% or 5.5 CGPA.

Specific requirements should be checked directly with the institution or department.

question: What is the minimum CGPA required for General category for PhD?
ground_truth: General category candidates need 60% or 6.0 CGPA for PhD admission, while SC/ST/PWD need 55% or 5.5 CGPA.
answer:
The minimum CGPA required for the General category for PhD admission is 6.0 on a 10-point scale, or 60% marks, for applicants with a Master’s degree [S1]. For applicants with a 4-year Bachelor’s degree from institutions other than Ministry of Education funded Technical Institutions, the minimum CGPA is 7.50 on a 10-point scale or 75% marks [S1]. Additionally, for candidates with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from IITs with a CGPA of 8.0 and above, the requirement of qualifying in a national-level test is exempted, but the minimum CGPA requirement is not explicitly stated as 6.0 in this context. 

Note: The general category requirement for Master’s degree applicants is 6.0 CGPA (60% marks), as per [S1].

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

3.1 Full-Time Sponsored Candidates

These candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

which admission is being sought.

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

Note:

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

2. Candidates admitted under R&T and PGT Schemes whose selection are

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

3. Candidates with or without GATE can apply. Preference will be given to GATE

qualified candidates.

4. No self-sponsored candidate will be admitted .

5. Sponsored students will not be eligible for any scholarship, prize etc.

question: Is GATE required for sponsored M.Tech candidates?
ground_truth: Sponsored candidates may be exempted from GATE requirement but must have work experience and sponsorship, department may conduct interview.
answer: No, GATE is not required for sponsored M.Tech candidates. The sources indicate that sponsored candidates (full-time and part-time) are admitted based on their work experience and sponsorship from a recognized organization, and the requirement of qualifying in a national level test such as GATE is waived for these candidates [S1]. Specifically, for sponsored candidates, the admission is based on the conditions related to work experience and sponsorship, and there is no mention of a GATE requirement [S1][S2]. Additionally, the document notes that candidates working in externally funded research projects may be considered for admission as part-time PG students and appointed as Project fellows/JRF, provided the project duration is at least one and a half years at the time of registration, and such candidates are considered under the project-funded category [S1]. This further implies that GATE is not a mandatory requirement for sponsored candidates.

3.1 Full-Time Sponsored Candidates

These candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

which admission is being sought.

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

qualified candidates.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

question: If a candidate has 58% in qualifying degree and belongs to General category, is he eligible for M.Tech?
ground_truth: No, General category requires 60% minimum, so 58% is not eligible for M.Tech.
answer:
No, a candidate with 58% in the qualifying degree and belonging to the General category is not eligible for M.Tech under the given criteria.

According to [S1], for General, GEN-EWS, and OBC category applicants, the minimum required CGPA is 6.0 on a 10-point scale or 60% marks. Since 58% is below the required 60%, the candidate does not meet the minimum percentage requirement. Additionally, the exemption from national-level test qualification (e.g., GATE/NET) applies only to specific categories such as IIT graduates, MBBS/BAMS, or those from MoE-funded institutions with a CGPA of 8.0 or above, which does not apply here.

Thus, the candidate fails to meet the minimum academic threshold for eligibility.

question: If a candidate has 58% in qualifying degree and belongs to General category, is he eligible for M.Tech?
ground_truth: No, General category requires 60% minimum, so 58% is not eligible for M.Tech.
answer:
No, a candidate with 58% in the qualifying degree and belonging to the General category is not eligible for M.Tech. according to the provided sources.

The eligibility criteria for the General category (GEN) require a minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of 6.0 on a 10-point scale, or 60% marks [S1]. Since 58% is below the required 60%, the candidate does not meet the minimum percentage threshold for admission in the General category.

Additionally, the sources specify that for candidates in the General category, a national-level test (such as GATE/NET) is required unless they meet specific exemptions (e.g., from IITs, MoE-funded institutions, or specific degree programs like MBBS/MS) [S1][S4]. However, the 60% minimum is a clear threshold for eligibility, and 58% does not meet it.

Therefore, the candidate does not meet the minimum percentage requirement for admission in the M.Tech. programme.

These candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

which admission is being sought.

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

Note:

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

2. Candidates admitted under R&T and PGT Schemes whose selection are

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

3. Candidates with or without GATE can apply. Preference will be given to GATE

qualified candidates.

4. No self-sponsored candidate will be admitted .

5. Sponsored students will not be eligible for any scholarship, prize etc.

answer: An M.Tech student can switch to a PhD after the first year, but the conditions vary by institution and country. Some institutions may require a research proposal, a letter of intent, and sometimes a separate admission process for PhD programs. The student may also need to meet specific eligibility criteria, such as a minimum GPA or research aptitude. It's advisable to consult the specific university's guidelines.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

question: If a sponsored candidate has only 1 year experience, can he apply for full-time sponsored M.Tech?
ground_truth: No, full-time sponsored candidates must have minimum two years full-time work experience till last date of application.
answer: Generally, most full-time sponsored M.Tech programs require a minimum of a bachelor's degree and may consider candidates with 1 year of work experience, but the eligibility depends on the specific university and program. However, sponsored M.Tech programs typically prioritize academic merit and may have restrictions on work experience. It's best to check directly with the institution or the specific program's admission criteria.

ground_truth: No, full-time sponsored candidates must have minimum two years full-time work experience till last date of application.
answer: No, a sponsored candidate with only 1 year of experience cannot apply for full-time sponsored M.Tech. The requirement specifies that full-time sponsored candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work experience. [S1]

question: If a candidate belongs to SC category with 56% marks, is he eligible for M.Tech?
ground_truth: Yes, SC category requires 55% minimum, so 56% makes him eligible.
answer: Eligibility for M.Tech depends on the specific university or institution's criteria, but generally, a candidate with 56% marks (which is above the 50% cutoff for many M.Tech programs) is eligible, regardless of SC category. However, SC category candidates may be eligible for reserved seats or preferential consideration, not automatic eligibility. The exact cutoff and rules vary by institution and program. For definitive answer, refer to the specific university's admission policy.

question: If a candidate belongs to SC category with 56% marks, is he eligible for M.Tech?
ground_truth: Yes, SC category requires 55% minimum, so 56% makes him eligible.
answer:
A candidate belonging to the SC category with 56% marks does not meet the eligibility criteria for M.Tech as specified in the document. 

According to [S1], SC category candidates require a minimum of 55% marks (or a CGPA of 5.50 on a 10-point scale). Since 56% exceeds 55%, the candidate meets the minimum percentage requirement.

Additionally, the candidate must either qualify in a national-level test (such as GATE/UGC-NET/CSIR-NET, etc.) or hold a national-level fellowship. The document does not specify any additional requirements beyond the percentage and test qualification.

Therefore, **if the candidate has qualified a national-level test or holds a national-level fellowship**, they are eligible for M.Tech. However, if neither is satisfied, they are not eligible.

Note: The 56% marks meet the SC category requirement, but the national-level test qualification or fellowship is still mandatory unless exempted under specific conditions (e.g., from IITs, or from MoE-funded institutions). 

Thus, **only if the candidate qualifies in a national-level test or holds a national-level fellowship** is he eligible for M.Tech. Without that, even with 56% marks, eligibility is not met.

question: If a candidate belongs to SC category with 56% marks, is he eligible for M.Tech?
ground_truth: Yes, SC category requires 55% minimum, so 56% makes him eligible.
answer: A candidate belonging to the SC category with 56% marks is eligible for M.Tech, as per the eligibility criteria specified in the document. For SC category candidates, the minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) required is 5.50 on a 10-point scale, or 55% marks. Since 56% exceeds the required 55%, the candidate meets the eligibility criterion [S1]. Additionally, if the candidate has qualified in a national-level test such as GATE/NET, or holds a national-level fellowship, the requirement of qualifying in such a test is exempted for SC category candidates [S1]. However, if the candidate has not qualified in such a test, the 55% marks (or 5.50 CGPA) is the minimum required for admission. Therefore, with 56% marks, the candidate is eligible.

question: If a candidate has AMIE but no B.Sc. or Diploma, is he eligible for M.Tech?
ground_truth: No, AMIE candidates must also possess B.Sc. or Diploma in engineering and three years experience to be eligible.
answer:
No, a candidate with only AMIE and no B.Sc. or Diploma is not eligible for M.Tech. according to the provided sources.

The document specifies that for admission in M.Tech. Hydrology (HYD), a candidate must have AMIE (Civil) with B.Sc. or Engineering Diploma qualifications and at least 3 years of research/teaching/other professional experience in responsible capacities [S2]. Similarly, for M.Tech. Mechanical & Industrial Engineering (MED), a Bachelor’s degree in relevant disciplines is required [S2]. There is no mention of eligibility for M.Tech. based solely on AMIE without a B.Sc. or Diploma. Therefore, without a B.Sc. or Diploma, the candidate does not meet the minimum educational qualification criteria for any M.Tech. programme as outlined in the documents.

3.1 Full-Time Sponsored Candidates

These candidates must have a minimum of two years of full-time work

experience till the last date of submission of application form in responsible

capacity in a Registered Firm/ Company/ Industry/ Educational and Research

Institution/Govt./Quasi Govt./Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in

which admission is being sought.

The Firm/Company/Industry shall either be a public sector undertaking or a

public limited undertaking registered in a stock exchange or a private concern

whose annual turnover during the past 2 years exceeds Rs. 5.0 crores (current

organization). For a candidate employed in an educational Institution, it should

be recognized by AICTE.

3.2. Part-Time Sponsored Candidates (Three years duration)

a) These candidates must satisfy condition specified at 3.1 as for full-time

sponsored candidates, with the additional requirement that such

organizations must be located either at Roorkee or within a radius of 20 km

from Roorkee.

b) There will not be any age restriction. However, preference will be given to

those who are below 45 years of age.

c) The part-time students will be required to attend all lectures, tutorials and

practical classes for the courses prescribed for them and must satisfy the

attendance requirements.

d) The status of a part-time student will not be changed from part-time to a

regular full-time student.

e) Members of the Staff of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee seeking

admission as part-time sponsored candidates should submit the sponsorship

certificate from the Registrar.

f) GATE qualified candidates be considered for admission in a PG programme,

as per his/her eligibility, as part time PG student and also simultaneously be

appointed as Project fellow/JRF in Externally funded Research Project,

provided the remaining duration of the project must be at least one and a

half year at the time of registration. The Staff working in externally funded

research projects (Under SRIC Office) in the Institute should submit the

sponsorship certificate from the appointing authority (SRIC).

Note:

1. The candidates working in Institute / University awarding PG degree itself are

not eligible for admission as part-time or full-time candidate, except QIP

candidates.

2. Candidates admitted under R&T and PGT Schemes whose selection are

made by Defence Head Quarters, are also required to apply online at IIT

Roorkee.

3. Candidates with or without GATE can apply. Preference will be given to GATE

qualified candidates.

4. No self-sponsored candidate will be admitted .

5. Sponsored students will not be eligible for any scholarship, prize etc.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

question: How many years of professional experience are required for AMIE candidates to be eligible for M.Tech?
ground_truth: AMIE candidates need at least three years research, teaching or professional experience in relevant field.
answer:
The provided sources indicate that AMIE (Associate Member of the Institution of Engineers, India) candidates with a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent are eligible for admission to M.Tech. programmes, but they must have at least three years of research, teaching, or other professional experience in responsible capacities.

Specifically, under the eligibility criteria for M.Tech. in Hydrology (S2), it states: "AMIE (Civil) with B.Sc. or Engineering Diploma qualifications with at least 3 years research/teaching /other professional experience in responsible capacities."

Therefore, AMIE candidates are required to have **at least 3 years** of professional experience to be eligible for M.Tech. programmes.

question: What are the admission categories for Indian candidates for M.Tech and what is the eligibility for each?
ground_truth: Categories include Regular with GATE, Sponsored full-time requiring 2 years experience, Part-time sponsored 3-year duration, and eligibility is 60% for General/OBC/EWS and 55% for SC/ST/PWD with four-year bachelor's degree.
answer:
For Indian candidates applying to M.Tech programs, admission is generally based on the following categories:

1. **General Category**: Candidates with no reservation. Eligibility: A bachelor’s degree (B.Tech/B.E.) with a minimum aggregate of 50% (or 55% for some institutions), with a relevant background in engineering or related field.

2. **OBC (Other Backward Classes)**: Reserved for OBC candidates. Eligibility: Same as General, but with a relaxation of 5% in marks (as per government norms), and must have OBC certification.

3. **SC/ST (Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe)**: Reserved for SC/ST candidates. Eligibility: Same as General, with 15% and 7.5% reservation respectively, and must have SC/ST certificate.

Note: Specific eligibility and reservation policies may vary by university, institute, or state. Admission is often through centralized entrance exams like GATE (for IITs, IISc, etc.) or direct admission based on B.Tech performance.

question: What are the admission categories for Indian candidates for M.Tech and what is the eligibility for each?
ground_truth: Categories include Regular with GATE, Sponsored full-time requiring 2 years experience, Part-time sponsored 3-year duration, and eligibility is 60% for General/OBC/EWS and 55% for SC/ST/PWD with four-year bachelor's degree.
answer:
The admission categories for Indian candidates for M.Tech at IIT Roorkee, as per the provided documents, include:

- General (GEN)
- EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)
- OBC (Other Backward Classes)
- SC (Scheduled Caste)
- ST (Scheduled Tribe)
- PWD (Persons with Disabilities)

Eligibility criteria for each category are as follows:

1. **General, EWS, and OBC Category**:
   - Minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of 6.0 on a 10-point scale, or 60% marks.
   - Candidates must qualify in a national-level test such as GATE, CEED, JEST, UGC-NET, CSIR-NET (including lectureship/Assistant Professorship/Ph.D. only), or hold a national-level fellowship.

2. **SC/ST/PWD Category**:
   - Minimum CGPA of 5.50 on a 10-point scale, or 55% marks.
   - Same test qualification or fellowship requirement as above.

3. **Exemptions**:
   - Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree (4 years) from Ministry of Education (MoE)-funded Technical Institutions (formerly CFTIs) with a CGPA of 8.0 or above are exempted from the national-level test requirement.
   - Candidates with a 4-year Bachelor’s degree from institutions other than MoE-funded institutions, with a minimum CGPA of 7.50 (75%) and a national-level test qualification, are eligible.
   - Candidates with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from IITs with a CGPA of 8.0 or above are exempted from the national-level test requirement.
   - Candidates with MBBS/BAMS/BHMS/BDS degrees from Indian universities

ground_truth: Categories include Regular with GATE, Sponsored full-time requiring 2 years experience, Part-time sponsored 3-year duration, and eligibility is 60% for General/OBC/EWS and 55% for SC/ST/PWD with four-year bachelor's degree.
answer:
The admission categories for Indian candidates for M.Tech at IIT Roorkee are as follows:

1. **General (GEN), GEN-EWS, OBC, SC, ST, PWD categories**:
   - **Minimum CGPA/Percentage**: 
     - GEN/GEN-EWS/OBC: Minimum CGPA of 6.0 on a 10-point scale or 60% marks.
     - SC/ST/PWD: Minimum CGPA of 5.50 on a 10-point scale or 55% marks.
   - **National Level Test**: Candidates must qualify in a national-level test such as GATE, CEED, JEST, UGC-NET, or CSIR-NET, or hold a national-level fellowship, unless exempted.
   - **Exemptions**:
     - Candidates with a B.Tech. or M.Sc. degree from Ministry of Education (MoE)-funded Technical Institutions (CFTIs) with a CGPA of 8.0 or above are exempted from the national-level test requirement.
     - Candidates with a 4-year Bachelor’s degree from institutions other than MoE-funded institutions, with a minimum CGPA of 7.50 on a 10-point scale or 75% marks, and who have qualified a national-level test, are eligible.
     - Candidates with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from IITs with a CGPA of 8.0 or above are exempted from the national-level test requirement.
     - Candidates with MBBS/BAMS/BHMS/BDS degrees from Indian universities/institutions with a minimum CGPA of 6.0 on a 10-point scale or 60% are exempted from the national-level test requirement.
     - Candidates with an MS/MD degree from Indian universities/institutions are exempt

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

- Fellowship support is available, though externally funded candidates (e.g., under project funding) may have different terms.

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

1.2 Campus

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in

ground_truth: Application fee is non-refundable, paid online via net banking/card/UPI. Important dates are listed in brochure and official website for application start, end, and selection.
answer:
The application fee payment process for PG admission 2026 requires candidates to pay the fee online using net banking or debit/credit card facilities. The fee amount is Rs. 500/- for General/GEN-EWS/OBC categories and Rs. 250/- for SC/ST/PwD categories. The fee must be paid per department/centre/school, and no payment will be accepted through other modes. Candidates are advised to submit their application well in advance, as no request for accepting an application after the last date will be entertained [S2][S4][S5].

Important dates for PG admission 2026 include:
- Candidates must apply online by accessing the URL: https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Admission%20To%20M.Tech.M.Arch.M.U.R.P.%20Programmes.html.
- The application must be submitted by the last date, with no requests for acceptance after that date.
- Document verification and joining will take place on July 13, 2026 (Saharanpur Campus for Paper and Packaging Technology, Polymer and Process Engineering) and July 14, 2026 (Roorkee Campus for Applied Mathematics & Scientific Computing and all other departments).
- Regular classes will start from July 16, 2026, following document verification [S3][S5].

Introduction

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has a rich legacy spanning 178 years, and it

is among the oldest engineering institutions in India. On September 21, 2001, it was formally

designated as an Indian Institute of Technology through a Government of India ordinance,

becoming theseventhIIT and earningthestatusof anInstitutionofNationalImportance.

Since its inception, IIT Roorkee has played a pivotal role in shaping the future of technology,

engineering, and research in the country. Over the years, the Institute has expanded its reach

beyond science and technology, making significant contributions to Architecture,

Management, Designand theHumanities &Social Sciences.

Today, IIT Roorkee continues to set higher benchmarks in education and it offers

undergraduate programs in 14 disciplines of Engineering, Architecture and Design, along with

six integrated Master’s programs in engineering and science. Additionally, the Institute offers

6 0 postgraduate programs across fields such as Engineering, Applied Science,

Architecture & Planning, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Design, and

Innovation. Further, fostering research and discoveries, it also offers doctoral programs

across all its Departments/Centres/ Schools.

With a strong foundation in academic excellence and a forward-looking vision, IIT Roorkee

continues to inspire generations of scholars, engineers, and leaders, driving progress and

innovationinIndiaandbeyond.

1.1 Location

IIT Roorkee is situated at the foothill of Himalayas, in Hardwar district, within the state of

Uttarakhand. It is the gateway to the pilgrim centres of Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Char

Dham (Gangotri, Yamnotri, Badrinath and Kedarnath), and tourist attraction cities like,

Dehradun and Mussoorie. Roorkee is well connected to Delhi by rail and road. It is

situated on National Highways 58 and 73 and is on Amritsar-Howrah main rail route.

Nearest airport to Roorkee is Dehradun’s Jolly Grant airport but most preferable

airport nearest from Roorkee is the New Delhi International Airport which is about 180

kilometers away.

The Institute has three campuses. The main campus is at Roorkee in Uttarakhand, and the

second one is 50 km away from the main Roorkee campus at Saharanpur, specialising in
